plot: On power-cut Saturday the Dough Bros try to keep the freezer cold for eight hours to save the Thanksgiving turkey; Plan Igloo and Plan Blanket fail as the frost drips, because scared Pim keeps opening the door to check, until Lolly reads Mom's 'KEEP SHUT' note and they realise a full freezer stays cold by itself — the problem was them; Lolly and Bup stay shut inside in the dark, Bup admits he's scared of the dark, Pim sits on his hands, and at five the turkey is still rock hard — then Mia runs in: her wobbly tooth fell out somewhere in the kitchen and the tooth fairy comes tonight.

script.title: Power Cut! Save the Thanksgiving Turkey

beats.say: The power's out! The freezer's getting warm! The turkey!
Eight hours with no power. Can a freezer even survive that?
Saturday, nine in the morning. The storm cut Maple Street's power.
Inside the freezer: two weeks of food and the Thanksgiving turkey.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Before work, Mom taped a note on the freezer: KEEP SHUT.
Simple physics, friends. Warm air sneaks in. Cold air sneaks out.
So we keep the cold in. I call it Plan Igloo.
Plan Igloo! I love it already. What is it?
Blue ice packs from the cooler bag. Stacked around the turkey.
The bros heave the freezer door open. White fog rolls out.
It's b-breathing on me! The freezer is breathing on me!
Lolly and Bup carry the ice packs in, one by one.
Stack them like bricks. Corners first. Like building a fort.
Not me. I'd only melt the frost. I'll guard the door.
Ten o'clock. Pim knocks. Is it still cold? He opens the door.
J-just checking! Still cold? Good! Okay! Bye!
Eleven o'clock. Pim checks again. Twelve o'clock. Again.
Pim, sweetie. Please stop opening the door every hour.
But what if it got warm while I wasn't l-looking?
One o'clock. A drip from the top shelf. Then another drip.
The frost is melting. Plan Igloo isn't enough!
Four hours left. If the turkey thaws, Thanksgiving is ruined!
Plan Blanket! We wrap the whole freezer in beach towels!
The bros drag Mia's striped beach towels across the floor.
Lolly and Bup pull them over the door. Pim pulls them off.
I have to check! I c-can't see if it's working!
The door opens again. And again. Drip. Drip. Drip.
Every time somebody checks, more warm air rushes in.
Lolly stops. She looks up at Mom's note on the door.
KEEP SHUT. Mom wasn't asking us to guard it.
She was telling us the freezer can save itself.
Of course! A full freezer stays cold for a whole day.
If nobody opens it. It was never the power. It was us.
It was me. I checked the most. I'm the warm air.
Then nobody checks again. Not you. Not me. Nobody.
Bup and I fix the ice packs inside. Then we shut it.
In there? For four hours? In the dark? With a turkey?
Two o'clock. Three hours left. The door closes behind them.
Click. Darkness. Only Lolly's icing sparkles a tiny bit.
Lolly. Real talk. I don't like the dark.
Brave Bup? Our leader? Scared of the dark?
Leaders aren't allowed to be scared. That's the rule.
Then today I'm the leader. And you can be scared.
Outside, Pim sits on his own hands so he can't open it.
Not checking. Not checking. Definitely not checking at all.
That's the bravest not-checking I have ever seen, Pim.
Five o'clock. A hum. The kitchen light blinks. Power's back!
Pim pulls the door open at last. Fog. Silence.
The turkey: rock hard. Every ice pack: still frozen.
Frozen solid. And I didn't cry. Much.
Sometimes the best help is not touching anything at all.
Then the front door bangs. Mia runs in, holding her cheek.
Her wobbly tooth fell out at breakfast. Somewhere in this dark kitchen.
A lost tooth. And the tooth fairy comes tonight!
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Power Cut! Save the Thanksgiving Turkey 🦃 (Ep 25)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"Leaders aren't allowed to be scared. That's what I thought." — Bup
A November storm cuts the power for eight hours, and the Thanksgiving turkey is in the freezer. The Dough Bros try every plan to keep it cold — and every plan makes it worse.

es.title: ¡Apagón! Salvemos el pavo de Acción de Gracias 🦃 (Ep 25)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Los líderes no pueden tener miedo. Eso creía." — Bup
Una tormenta de noviembre corta la luz ocho horas y el pavo de Acción de Gracias está en el congelador. Los Dough Bros prueban todos los planes para mantenerlo frío… y cada plan lo empeora.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Apagão! Salve o peru de Ação de Graças 🦃 (Ep 25)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Líderes não podem ter medo. Era o que eu achava." — Bup
Uma tempestade de novembro corta a energia por oito horas, e o peru de Ação de Graças está no freezer. Os Dough Bros tentam todos os planos para mantê-lo gelado — e cada plano piora tudo.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.description:
ماذا تتوقع أن يحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"القادة لا يُسمح لهم بالخوف. هكذا كنت أظن." — باب
عاصفة نوفمبر تقطع الكهرباء ثماني ساعات، وديك عيد الشكر في الفريزر. يجرّب Dough Bros كل خطة لإبقائه باردًا — وكل خطة تزيد الأمر سوءًا.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Panne de courant ! Sauvons la dinde de Thanksgiving 🦃 (Ep 25)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la suite ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Un chef n'a pas le droit d'avoir peur. C'est ce que je croyais." — Bup
Une tempête de novembre coupe le courant pendant huit heures, et la dinde de Thanksgiving est au congélateur. Les Dough Bros essaient tous les plans pour la garder froide… et chaque plan empire tout.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「リーダーはこわがっちゃダメ。そう思ってた。」— バップ
11月の嵐で8時間の停電。冷凍庫には感謝祭の七面鳥。ドウ・ブロスは冷たさを守ろうとあらゆる作戦をためすけど、どれも逆効果に…。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 정전! 추수감사절 칠면조를 지켜라 🦃 (Ep 25)
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날 것 같나요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"리더는 무서워하면 안 돼. 그렇게 생각했어." — 법

#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Stromausfall! Rettet den Thanksgiving-Truthahn 🦃 (Ep 25)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Anführer dürfen keine Angst haben. Dachte ich jedenfalls." — Bup
Ein Novembersturm legt den Strom für acht Stunden lahm, und der Thanksgiving-Truthahn liegt im Gefrierschrank. Die Dough Bros probieren jeden Plan, um ihn kalt zu halten – und jeder Plan macht es schlimmer.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
